section_summary.extract_value: This section details the assessment of creative potential using three alternate uses (AU) tasks and three instances (IN) tasks. Participants generated ideas on a PC for two minutes per task and then ranked their responses. Four students rated the originality of responses on a four-point scale, achieving mean interrater reliabilities of ICC = .80 for AU tasks and ICC = .69 for IN tasks. Three scores of creative potential were computed: ideational fluency, Top 2 originality, and average originality. The text describes a single methodology for assessing creative potential.
